Preview summary
Select at least one item.
Concern: %1$s\nPrepared: %2$s · Concern revision %3$d\nPersonal notes for clinical discussion, not a diagnosis or a clinician-reviewed report.

Only selected items are shared. This is not a complete medical history or evidence of recovery. Names, internal IDs, file paths and original attachments are not automatically included; free-text entries may still identify you. Review and deselect any private entries. Original records remain separate and should be checked when needed. This summary does not book an appointment or contact a clinician.
This preview includes only the eight most recent available measurements. Earlier records remain in the measurement history.
This preview includes only the first eight questions in the current scope. More questions remain in the question ledger.
Collection condition
Recorded source
No separate measurement context is included for this metric. This does not establish absence of relevant symptoms or conditions.
User-confirmed context applies only to the current measurement revision. Unknown does not mean no. Current symptoms have not been assessed by this summary.
User-accepted plan, not verified clinician instructions. Execution feedback does not establish clinical improvement.
The source basis has changed. This action requires review; the summary does not reauthorize it.
Source context changed. The previous answer is not included as a current fact.

No profile fields or background entries have been selected for this concern. Unselected or missing information does not mean no medical history, medication or allergy.

Share %1$d selected items and the summary heading as readable text? The chosen app can retain this information. No original attachments are included. Cancelling does not share anything; opening the share sheet does not prove delivery.

Too much content for a text summary. Deselect some items and review the smaller scope.
